categories.main_business_segments: Sieyuan Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the power transmission and distribution equipment industry, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, sales, and services of power system primary equipment (traditional mechanical electrical equipment), secondary equipment (control electrical equipment), energy storage, and power quality management devices. The company also engages in engineering procurement and construction (EPC) projects. Key products include GIS and GIL up to 750kV, high-voltage circuit breakers, transformers, reactors, current and voltage transformers, capacitors, and automotive electronic components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in high-voltage electrical equipment, flexible DC transmission, energy storage systems, and power quality solutions. It emphasizes innovation in flexible DC, low-frequency solutions, microgrid and distributed photovoltaic integrated solutions, and high-rate energy storage components such as supercapacitors and lithium batteries. Production is typically made-to-order (MTO) or engineered-to-order (ETO) due to high customization, with comprehensive EPC capabilities covering design, procurement, construction, and commissioning.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sieyuan serves primarily electric power grid companies, including State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, as well as industries such as power generation (including renewable energy), rail transit, petrochemical, and metallurgy. The company also targets overseas markets with products certified in countries like the UK, Italy, Saudi Arabia, and Kuwait. Its customer base includes major utilities and industrial enterprises requiring customized power transmission and distribution solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant revenue contributions from East China, North China, South China, Northeast, Central, Northwest, and Southwest regions. It has a growing international presence with subsidiaries and operations in over 20 countries including Kenya, Hong Kong, UAE, Mexico, Switzerland, Russia, Brazil, Egypt, Zambia, Ivory Coast, Philippines, Sierra Leone, Botswana, Nigeria, Spain, Uzbekistan, India, and the USA. Overseas revenue accounted for over 20% of total sales in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sieyuan Electric operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the power equipment supply chain. It manufactures core electrical equipment and components, provides engineering and construction services (EPC), and delivers integrated solutions for power transmission and distribution systems. The company also engages in import and export of equipment and materials, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the power equipment industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation aligned with the development of new power systems and green energy transitions. R&D focuses on flexible DC transmission, energy storage systems, supercapacitors, automotive electronics, and smart grid technologies. It maintains a strong patent portfolio with 897 patents and 166 software copyrights. Strategic initiatives include expanding product lines, enhancing technology platforms, and increasing R&D investment to sustain technological leadership and market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Sieyuan generates revenue mainly through the sale of customized power transmission and distribution equipment and related components, as well as EPC engineering contracts. The company operates on a direct sales model with order-based production. Additional revenue streams include leasing of owned equipment and investment income from financial assets. Government subsidies and service contracts also contribute to income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sieyuan is positioned as a leading domestic player in the power transmission and distribution equipment sector, recognized for its comprehensive product portfolio and technological capabilities. It competes with other major Chinese electrical equipment manufacturers and international suppliers in both domestic and overseas markets. The company’s emphasis on innovation, quality, and integrated solutions strengthens its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sieyuan Electric reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 15.46 billion, a 24.06% increase over 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.05 billion, up 31.42%. Total assets reached RMB 23.47 billion, growing 25.3% year-over-year. The company’s R&D expenditure was RMB 1.11 billion, representing 7.18% of revenue. Cash flow from operations was positive at RMB 2.46 billion, reflecting steady growth and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sieyuan Electric emphasizes innovation-driven development, offering highly customized and integrated power system solutions that cover primary and secondary equipment, energy storage, and power quality management. Its competitive differentiation lies in its strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and ability to provide turnkey EPC services. The company’s commitment to quality, customer-centric service, and participation in national green energy projects enhances its brand reputation and customer trust.
